Name: Noor Kundan Jhumka Earrings
Short description: Bell-shaped gold-tone jhumkas set with white kundan stones and a fringe of faux pearls.
Description:
Our Noor jhumkas pair a floral kundan stud with a domed bell finished in fine gold-tone plating and edged with faux pearls. Lightweight enough for a full evening, they suit mehndi, Eid and wedding looks.

Material: brass alloy with gold-tone plating, kundan glass stones, faux pearls.
Length: approx. 5.5 cm. Push-back closure.
Care: keep dry, avoid perfume, store in the Ayatcollections pouch.

Name: Zara Textured Hoop Earrings
Short description: Bold ribbed gold-tone hoops for everyday shine.
Description:
Zara drops are shaped like an opening bloom in a warm rose-gold tone, hung on slim hook fittings. Pretty with western and eastern outfits alike.

Material: alloy with rose-gold-tone plating.
Length: approx. 3 cm. Hook closure.
Care: wipe with a soft dry cloth after wearing.

Name: Rania Pavé Heart Pendant
Short description: A crystal-studded heart pendant on a delicate chain.
Description:
Rania layers rows of gold-tone beads and petals with coloured stone accents for a classic festive look. Wear it with a matching pair of jhumkas for mehndi or Eid.

Material: alloy with gold-tone plating, glass stones.
Fit: adjustable dori, 36–44 cm.
Care: store flat in its box; avoid water and perfume.

Short description: Matching necklace, earrings and ring with sliding crystal bars.

Material: alloy with gold-tone plating.
Length: 45 cm with 5 cm extender. Lobster clasp.
Care: fasten the clasp before storing.

Name: Laila Gold Bangle Set
Short description: Four polished gold-tone bangles, sold as a set. Choose your bangle size.

Material: alloy with gold-tone plating.
Sizes: 2.4 (small), 2.6 (medium), 2.8 (large) — the inner diameter in inches.
Care: remove before washing hands; store in the pouch.

Care: clean gently with a soft dry cloth.
